verdict.rationale: Kick documents managing multiple entities from one workspace. Each entity has its own books, reports and transaction history, shared expenses can be split across entities, and the Plus plan allows unlimited entities. However, nothing in the evidence shows consolidated financial statements produced across entities, which is the second half of the story. Missing for 10: documented consolidated P&L/Balance Sheet across entities, intercompany eliminations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them

citations.quote: If you own more than one business, or have a holding company structure, Kick lets you manage all your entities from a single workspace.
Each entity has its own books, reports, and transaction history.
you can split a single transaction across multiple entities by amount or percentage.
Plus — $100/mo — Unlimited entities, classes, accrual ledger, AR & AP
